name: Dependencies
description: Lists the vulnerable and out-of-date packages of the project from its lockfile, when you ask, and hands any of them to an agent. Agents read the last audit instead of running it again.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs one declared command, a Node script that calls your package manager's read-only audit and outdated commands (pnpm, npm, yarn, cargo, pip) when you click; keeps the last result in the kit's own data folder; and sends a package to an agent of the workspace only when you click.

audit.description: Audits the project's dependencies: finds its lockfile and runs the package manager's read-only audit and outdated commands. Installs, fixes and updates nothing.
